title: John 1:29 — “Behold, the Lamb of God”
summary: John 1:29: seeing Jesus coming, John says, “Behold, the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!” Jesus is in red, 'Lamb' in grey, and 'God' in blue, red and gold.

text.text: 29 The next day he saw Jesus coming to him and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!

keywords: takes away the sin of the world
taketh away the sin of the world
